verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own corporations page publishes at least one exact dollar amount, a $150 same-day counter service fee. Another page notes that nonprofit corporations and LLPs can file the Initial Report at formation with no additional fee. Beyond that, the pack shows no published amounts for core transactions such as formation, foreign registration, annual reports, certificates or closures. missing for 10: published filing-fee amounts for formation, foreign registration, annual report, amendments, reinstatement, dissolution, certificates/apostilles and trademarks, plus any fee schedule page.

support.subject: As a founder, the exact statutory fees for my transaction are published on the service's own pages — amounts, not a contact form

citations.quote: We charge a $150 same-day service fee and record all visits to public record.
Nonprofit corporations and Limited Liability Partnerships may file their Initial Report at the time of formation without an additional fee
